subject: Standby keystore restore proof + RTO/RPO sampling
messages:
From: Grace Liu <security@firstbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Thomas Reed <audit@sig-partner.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: standby keystore restore proof + sample RTO/RPO traces

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the tabletop last month. As part of FirstBridge's SIG intake we need a concise package showing:

- A reproducible standby keystore restore (exact steps and evidence) against a seeded test keyset.
- Measured RTO and RPO samples for the standby->primary cutover (we need at least three runs, warm and cold).
- KV cache warm times (time-to-first-token and time-to-stable-throughput) during the restore window.
- A short witness recording (5–10 minutes) demonstrating the restore and the console/s3 logs.
- A signed attestation we can include in the SIG response if everything matches the controls.

Deliverables we expect: runbook excerpt, restore logs (CSV), KV sample timestamps, mp4 witness clip, and a one-page attestation PDF. Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts by 2027-06-07 PST? If you need to schedule a live witness window we can coordinate.

Thanks,
Grace Liu
Senior InfoSec Manager
FirstBridge Bank

--
Thomas Reed will be on copy for auditor intake and may ask for a few clarifying items after review.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Grace Liu <security@firstbridge.com>
Cc: Thomas Reed <audit@sig-partner.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: standby keystore restore proof + sample RTO/RPO traces

Hi Grace — we can do this. Thanks for the clear checklist.

High-level plan:
1) Ops will run three scripted restore trials in our staging multi-az standby (two warm, one cold) and collect S3 restore logs and KV cache timestamps.
2) We will capture a 7-minute screen recording showing the restore initiation, keystore access logs, and the console showing the restored keys in the keystore.
3) Deliver artifacts: runbook excerpt (PDF), s3-restore-log CSV, kv_warm_cache_samples TSV, witness mp4, and a draft attestation PDF for your review.
4) We'll provide timestamps that map to your requested RTO (time-to-serve) and RPO (last-successful-checkpoint).

We have an ops window scheduled for 2027-06-02 at 09:00 PT for this work. Marissa will run the playback and record the clip; Dev will collect the KV traces. Priya will prepare the attestation draft and the runbook excerpt.

Attachments I'm sending now (stubs): runbook_excerpt_standby_keystore.pdf, s3-restore-log-20270527.csv, kv_warm_cache_samples.tsv. I'll follow up with the screen recording and the signed attestation.

If you'd like a live witness instead of the recording, please let us know which 30–45 minute slot on 2027-06-02 or 2027-06-03 works for you and we'll book it.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: runbook_excerpt_standby_keystore.pdf (excerpt, steps 7–14), s3-restore-log-20270527.csv, kv_warm_cache_samples.tsv

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: standby keystore restore proof + sample RTO/RPO traces

Quick ops notes for the run:
- I'll seed the staging standby with the test keyset (keyset-id: testk-20270527) at 08:30 PT on 2027-06-02.
- Marissa: please start the screen capture at 08:55, begin the restore at 09:00, and capture the console logs + S3 retrieval pane. Use the dedicated recording VM and upload to the Drive link listed in Evelyn's reply.
- I'll instrument the kv cache timeline with the tracer (kv-trace v2) — output will be kv_warm_cache_samples.tsv. Expect the first-token time, first-1000-token throughput ramp, and time-to-stable-throughput metrics.
- We'll tag each run in the logs as run-1, run-2, run-3 and include UTC timestamps for correlation.

I'll also export the S3 GET/HEAD logs and a minimal audit chain (s3-restore-log-20270527.csv). If we see variance > 30% between warm/cold runs on RTO we'll flag it and include a short explainer.

Dev
SRE (Recovery)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: standby keystore restore artifacts + attestation link

Grace / Thomas —

Thanks for the patience. Per your checklist we've attached the completed artifacts to this thread and uploaded originals to the Drive folder. Deliverables delivered today:

- runbook_excerpt_standby_keystore.pdf (steps, low-level commands, and recovery owner list)
- s3-restore-log-20270527.csv (S3 GET/HEAD events filtered to the restore window)
- kv_warm_cache_samples.tsv (first-token, first-1000, stable throughput timestamps for run-1..3)
- witness_screen_recording_20270602.mp4 (7:14) — brief narration + console timestamps annotated
- signed-attestation-draft.pdf (initial draft; Priya prepared the language).

Next steps for you: review the attestation PDF and, if acceptable, sign via DocuSign at: https://www.docusign.com/eq/ABC123-example. If you prefer a live witness we have an available slot on 2027-06-04 10:00 PT (30 min).

Acceptance criteria we propose: RTO measured as time-to-first-token, RPO measured as last checkpoint timestamp difference, and KV warm time measured to stable throughput. We documented warm vs cold numbers in the TSV and included short commentary in the runbook excerpt where variance exceeds 30%.

Please confirm receipt and whether you want the live slot. If Thomas has follow-ups from the SIG intake we'll handle them promptly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference
